project_type: Full-stack web app: Cloudflare Workers edge proxy (TypeScript) + FastAPI backend (Python) + React frontend
build_system: npm/vitest for edge worker, pip/pytest for backend
test_framework: vitest for apps/edge/tests/*.test.ts, pytest with httpx AsyncClient for apps/backend/tests/
test_command: cd apps/edge && npx vitest run && cd ../../apps/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -x
verification_instructions: 1. Run tsc --noEmit in apps/edge to check TypeScript compilation. 2. Run vitest in apps/edge for unit tests. 3. Run pytest in apps/backend for Python tests.
setup_instructions: 1. cd apps/edge && npm install. 2. cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. No Docker daemon needed for testing; tests use vitest (edge) and pytest with mocks (backend).
contribution_requirements: Branch from main; TypeScript strict mode; Python type hints encouraged; tests required for new logic.
key_patterns: Edge worker: middleware files in apps/edge/src/middleware/, tests in apps/edge/tests/. Backend: FastAPI app with middleware in main.py, config in config.py, routes in app/api/v1/, tests in apps/backend/tests/ with conftest.py providing async fixtures.
directory_structure: apps/edge/ - Cloudflare Workers edge proxy with bot protection, JWT, CORS, rate limiting. apps/backend/ - FastAPI application with MongoDB (Beanie ODM), Redis rate limiting, admin panel. apps/frontend/ - React SPA (not modified in this task).
